Occurrences.Kwic: 墮他窠臼。如油入麵不得出頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (天目中峰廣錄). Zhongfeng Mingben owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一新一舊，跳出窠臼。一出一入，胡餅裏呷汁。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Miyin Xianjie owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 殺佛殺祖，盡落古人圜繢；行棒行喝，不脫今時窠臼。

Occurrences.Kwic: 到這裏不拘格式。不躡前蹤。不昧當機。如何舉唱明眼漢沒窠臼。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Yuanwu Keqin owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雖不立窠臼露布，久之學徒妄認，亦成窠臼露布也。盖以無窠臼為窠臼

Occurrences.Kwic: 師說法格外作用不守規轍脫略窠臼。至於室中機緣尤為嶮峻不可湊泊。

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：倩女離魂事若何？師曰：月淡花移影。曰：未審他是業識？是意生？師曰：風搖水作波。曰：畢竟是一個？是兩個？師曰：形影不須彰，便脫狐窠臼。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈會元續略). Xueguan Zhiyin owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問：至道無難，唯嫌揀擇。是時人窠臼否？師曰：曾有人問我，老僧直得五年分疏不下。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (御選語錄). Zhaozhou Congshen owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Senses.Explanation: a nest or mortar; in the Chan record, a fixed mould into which words and conduct settle. The corpus speaks of falling into another's rut (墮他窠臼, "fall into his fixed rut") as oil enters flour and cannot get out, and of both inherited gestures and current fashions as ruts: "killing buddhas and patriarchs" falls within the old people's enclosure, while wielding the staff and shout does not escape the present-day rut (殺佛殺祖，盡落古人圜繢；行棒行喝，不脫今時窠臼). One record pairs new and old while saying "jump out of the rut" (一新一舊，跳出窠臼). The decisive corpus warning is recursive: pupils may mistake the identified master's refusal to establish a rut and thereby make "no rut" into a rut (以無窠臼為窠臼, "take having no rut as a rut"). Thus the Chan deviation is not merely an ordinary habit: the term names repeatable religious speech, gestures, formats, and even anti-formulas once followers preserve them as a template.
